consequences.text: FinePrint finds Pangle by code whose names start with com.bytedance, com.pgl or com.pangle.global. Other ByteDance code can start with com.bytedance too, such as TikTok's older developer kit, so finding it doesn't by itself show the app shows Pangle ads.
